title: Aurora Server
description: A dedicated Ubuntu home server infrastructure running production workloads, including portfolio services, automated CI/CD deployment pipelines via self-hosted GitHub Actions runners, zero-trust tunnels, and GPU-accelerated Docker containers.
Highlights: Automated CI/CD deployment pipeline utilizing self-hosted GitHub Actions runners with unprivileged deployer sandboxing and passwordless Docker control
Secure external access via Cloudflare Zero Trust tunnels and host Nginx reverse proxy without exposing public inbound firewall ports
Hardware-accelerated container runtime powered by NVIDIA Container Toolkit passthrough for GPU video rendering and CUDA workloads
Hardened web terminal interface via ttyd secured with Google Authenticator PAM Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)
